canvas.note: All three PNGs are full canvas size. Place each at x=0, y=0 in this order: bg-no-arms, arm-man, arm-cat.

animation_idea.idle: both arms breathe: man 0 to -1 deg, cat 0 to 1 deg, 3s ease-in-out loop
animation_idea.swat: cat winds up -10 deg (0.25s), swats +6 deg (0.12s, overshoot), returns 0 (0.4s); man flinches +3 deg right after the swat hits, returns 0
animation_idea.trigger: hover or tap on the cat; play swat once every ~6s while idle on touch devices
